[[File:Depa_Billaba_TPM.png|thumb|right|250px|Depa Billaba wearing the Marks of Illumination.]]
The '''Marks of Illumination''' were symbols worn by [[Chalactan Adepts/Legends|Chalactan Adepts]] on their faces. The [[Lesser Mark of Illumination|Lesser Mark]] was worn between the [[eye]]s by those who joined the Adepts, while the [[Greater Mark of Illumination|Greater Mark]] was worn above it by those deemed to have reached [[Chalactan Enlightenment]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactan]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Depa Billaba]] attained both marks, but removed her Greater Mark as a result of her experiences during the [[Summertime War]] on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]].<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>
